turns.q: Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
turns.replyTail: Honestly, I can’t say the pricier option is worth it without knowing what the two options include. Invisalign treatment is personalized, and cost can vary by treatment plan. The higher-priced option may not provide better value if the lower-priced plan already addresses your treatment needs. Compare the total price, what treatment is included, insurance contribution, and any payment-plan terms before deciding. Your doctor can explain what additional treatment the more expensive option provides.
